extracted.name: A Simply Perfect Roast Turkey
extracted.description: This simply perfect roast turkey recipe is all you need for the holidays — it's seasoned with just salt and pepper and basted with rich turkey stock.
ingredient_lines: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Place a rack in the lowest position of the oven.
Remove turkey neck and giblets; pat dry with paper towels. Place breast-side up, on a rack in a large roasting pan.
Loosely fill cavity with stuffing. Rub skin with butter; season with salt and pepper.
Pour 2 cups of turkey stock into the roasting pan.
Loosely tent turkey with aluminum foil; roast for 2 ½ hours, basting with pan juices every 30 minutes. When drippings evaporate, add remaining stock to the pan, 1 to 2 cups at a time.
Remove foil and continue roasting until a meat thermometer inserted in thickest part of thigh reads 165 degrees F (75 degrees C), about 1 ½ hours more.
Let stand for 20 to 30 minutes before carving.
